subject.title: fix(memory): keep implicit embeddings recall available

question: Should existing implicit or legacy-auto OpenAI memory indexes continue serving validated read-only FTS recall when direct OpenAI API-key authentication becomes unavailable?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive fallback decision affecting existing persisted memory indexes and the user-visible meaning of an embedding-auth outage; the implementation evidence is strong, but the durable product policy requires owner intent.

options.title: Accept documented FTS fallback
options.body: Merge the patch and make unavailable implicit embeddings degrade to validated memory-file lexical recall while explicit providers continue to fail closed.

options.title: Keep unavailable-search behavior
options.body: Reject the fallback transition and update the conflicting documentation or define a narrower recovery policy before changing runtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept documented FTS fallback
recommendation.body: Merge the patch and make unavailable implicit embeddings degrade to validated memory-file lexical recall while explicit providers continue to fail closed.

likelyOwner.reason: They can clarify the demonstrated behavior and its intended compatibility contract, though a current Memory Core code owner should make the final product decision.
